Package com.here.sdk.mapdata.ocm

Class FunctionalClassAttributeValues

java.lang.Object
com.here.sdk.mapdata.ocm.FunctionalClassAttributeValues
public final class FunctionalClassAttributeValues extends Object

Functional Class defines a hierarchical network used to determine a logical and efficient route. Functional Class = 1, 2, 3, and 4 roads are connected to form a comprehensive road network for navigation of long distance, mid-range and short routes in any given coverage area. May be used to render on a map display an amount of road network compatible to zoom level defined by the end user.

Note: This is a beta release of this feature and may contain bugs or exhibit unexpected behaviour. Related APIs are subject to change without a deprecation process.
